issue_request: FHIR-32510 was a Published FHIR-core Procedure change request from Patient Care, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking to replace guidance that Procedure.reason.concept and Procedure.reason.reference could describe different reasons with guidance that, for a single Procedure.reason, both parts are expected to be consistent.

The same wording was later carried into source/procedure/procedure-event-mapping-exceptions.xml when mapping exception files were added.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to Patient Care. Current CodeableReference guidance in source/references.html says that when both concept and reference are present they are expected to be consistent, matching the issue rationale. Same-commit Jira checks show FHIR-32504 and FHIR-32509 were separate Procedure cleanup requests; they do not alter the FHIR-32510 consistency decision. Zulip and Confluence text searches found no conflicting discussion, and Confluence references identify the 2022-08-18 Patient Care meeting page for FHIR-32510.
